# routable address replaced with 203.0.113.113 (TEST-NET-3). Loopback,
# 0.0.0.0, ports, states and uids are exactly as the kernel reported them:
# those are what the parser reads, and the uid spread is the point — a
# real machine has other people's listeners on it.
